shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak roles using Keycloak API

options.name: attributes
options.description: A dict of key/value pairs to set as custom attributes for the role. Values may be single values (for example a string) or a list of strings.

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: client_id
options.description: If the role is a client role, the client ID under which it resides. If this parameter is absent, the role is considered a realm role.

options.name: composite
options.description: If V(true), the role is a composition of other realm and/or client role.

options.name: composites
options.description: List of roles to include to the composite realm role. If the composite role is a client role, the C(clientId) (not ID of the client) must be specified.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the role. This parameter is required.

options.name: realm
options.description: The Keycloak realm under which this role resides.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the role. On V(present), the role is created if it does not yet exist, or updated with the parameters you provide. On V(absent), the role is removed if it exists.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
